title: eludite.nuget.installed input
description: Installed: the packages of the open solution's projects, as the Manage NuGet Packages window's Installed tab lists them, read from the projects and their restore output (project.assets.json).

project.description: A project of the open solution: its name (`App`) or the absolute path of its project file.

vulnerabilities.description: Ask the sources for vulnerability and deprecation data (default true; false reads files only).
